# saml — SAML 2.0

[All groups](README.md)

## saml metadata

Load and summarise SAML IdP metadata: entity ID, SSO and SLO endpoints per binding, NameID formats and signing certificates with expiry.

MCP tool: `saml_metadata`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. **Required.** May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml authn_request

Build (and optionally sign) a SAML 2.0 AuthnRequest without sending it. Returns the XML, the encoded form and a ready redirect URL or auto-submitting POST form.

MCP tool: `saml_authn_request`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sso-url` | string | IdP SSO URL, overriding metadata. |
| `--binding` | string | Binding used to send the AuthnRequest. Default `redirect`. One of `redirect`, `post`. |
| `--name-id-format` | string | Requested NameID format URI. |
| `--authn-context` | string | Requested AuthnContextClassRef URI. |
| `--force-authn` | bool | Set ForceAuthn=true. |
| `--is-passive` | bool | Set IsPassive=true. |
| `--relay-state` | string | RelayState to send. |
| `--sign` | bool | Sign the request with sp_key. |
| `--response-binding` | string | Binding the IdP should answer with: post, or artifact (resolved over SOAP). Default `post`. One of `post`, `artifact`. |
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Entity ID this tool presents as the service provider. Default `idpdbg`. |
| `--sp-key` | string | SP RSA private key (PEM inline or a path) for signing requests and decrypting assertions. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-cert` | string | SP certificate (PEM inline or a path). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--acs-url` | string | Assertion Consumer Service URL to ask the IdP to respond to. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml login

Run SP-initiated SAML SSO end to end: listen on a local Assertion Consumer Service, send an AuthnRequest through the browser, capture the SAMLResponse and verify its signature, conditions, audience and recipient. Blocks until the person finishes signing in. Register the ACS URL and SP entity ID with the IdP first (see saml sp_metadata).

MCP tool: `saml_login`. Opens a browser and waits for a person.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--idp-cert` | string | IdP signing certificate (PEM inline or a path), instead of or in addition to metadata. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sso-url` | string | IdP SSO URL, overriding metadata. |
| `--binding` | string | Binding used to send the AuthnRequest. Default `redirect`. One of `redirect`, `post`. |
| `--name-id-format` | string | Requested NameID format URI. |
| `--authn-context` | string | Requested AuthnContextClassRef URI. |
| `--force-authn` | bool | Set ForceAuthn=true. |
| `--is-passive` | bool | Set IsPassive=true. |
| `--relay-state` | string | RelayState to send. |
| `--sign` | bool | Sign the request with sp_key. |
| `--response-binding` | string | Binding the IdP should answer with: post, or artifact (resolved over SOAP). Default `post`. One of `post`, `artifact`. |
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Entity ID this tool presents as the service provider. Default `idpdbg`. |
| `--sp-key` | string | SP RSA private key (PEM inline or a path) for signing requests and decrypting assertions. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-cert` | string | SP certificate (PEM inline or a path). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--acs-port` | int | Loopback port for the local ACS. Default `8766`. |
| `--ars-url` | string | ArtifactResolutionService URL, overriding metadata (artifact responses). |
| `--mtls-cert` | string | Client certificate for mutual TLS to the resolution service. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--mtls-key` | string | Private key for mtls_cert. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--acs-path` | string | Path of the local ACS. Default `/saml/acs`. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |
| `--open-browser` | bool | Open the system browser automatically. Default `true`. |
| `--wait` | int | Seconds to wait for the person to finish in the browser. Default `180`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml decode

Decode and inspect a SAML message (Response, Assertion, AuthnRequest, Logout messages): raw XML, base64, DEFLATE+base64 or a whole redirect URL. Given the IdP metadata or certificate it verifies signatures; given the SP details it checks audience, recipient and timing, and decrypts encrypted assertions.

MCP tool: `saml_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--message` | string | The SAML message in any encoding (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--idp-cert` | string | IdP signing certificate (PEM inline or a path), instead of or in addition to metadata. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Expected audience (the SP entity ID). |
| `--acs-url` | string | Expected Destination / Recipient (the ACS URL). |
| `--in-response-to` | string | ID of the AuthnRequest the response must answer. |
| `--sp-key` | string | SP RSA private key (PEM inline or a path) to decrypt an EncryptedAssertion. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml sp_metadata

Generate SP metadata XML for this tool, to register it with an IdP before running saml login.

MCP tool: `saml_sp_metadata`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Entity ID this tool presents as the service provider. Default `idpdbg`. |
| `--sp-cert` | string | SP certificate (PEM inline or a path). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--acs-url` | string | ACS URL. Default `http://localhost:8766/saml/acs`. |
| `--slo-url` | string | SingleLogoutService URL (empty to leave it out). Default `http://localhost:8766/saml/slo`. |
| `--sign` | bool | Declare AuthnRequestsSigned=true. |
| `--out` | string | Write the XML to this file as well. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml logout

Run SP-initiated SAML Single Logout: send a LogoutRequest through the browser (Redirect or POST binding), capture the LogoutResponse on a local SingleLogoutService and check its status, InResponseTo, issuer and signature (enveloped or Redirect-binding). Use the NameID and SessionIndex from a saml login.

MCP tool: `saml_logout`. Opens a browser and waits for a person.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--idp-cert` | string | IdP signing certificate (PEM inline or a path), instead of or in addition to metadata. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Entity ID this tool presents as the service provider. Default `idpdbg`. |
| `--sp-key` | string | SP RSA private key (PEM inline or a path) for signing requests and decrypting assertions. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-cert` | string | SP certificate (PEM inline or a path). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--slo-url` | string | IdP SingleLogoutService URL, overriding metadata. |
| `--binding` | string | Binding used to send the LogoutRequest. Default `redirect`. One of `redirect`, `post`. |
| `--name-id` | string | NameID of the session to end. **Required.** |
| `--name-id-format` | string | Format of that NameID. |
| `--session-index` | string | SessionIndex from the AuthnStatement. |
| `--sign` | bool | Sign the LogoutRequest with sp_key (recommended). |
| `--relay-state` | string | RelayState to send. |
| `--slo-port` | int | Loopback port for the local SingleLogoutService. Default `8766`. |
| `--slo-path` | string | Path of the local SingleLogoutService. Default `/saml/slo`. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |
| `--open-browser` | bool | Open the system browser automatically. Default `true`. |
| `--wait` | int | Seconds to wait for the person to finish in the browser. Default `180`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## saml resolve_artifact

Resolve a SAML artifact (HTTP-Artifact binding): decode it, check its SourceID against the IdP, send a (signed) ArtifactResolve over SOAP to the IdP's ArtifactResolutionService, and analyse the message it returns like saml decode. Artifacts are single-use.

MCP tool: `saml_resolve_artifact`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--artifact` | string | The SAMLart value. **Required.** |
| `--ars-url` | string | ArtifactResolutionService URL, overriding metadata. |
| `--idp-metadata` | string | IdP metadata: a URL, a file path or inline XML. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--idp-cert` | string | IdP signing certificate (PEM inline or a path), instead of or in addition to metadata. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-entity-id` | string | Entity ID this tool presents as the service provider. Default `idpdbg`. |
| `--sp-key` | string | SP RSA private key (PEM inline or a path) for signing requests and decrypting assertions. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sp-cert` | string | SP certificate (PEM inline or a path). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--mtls-cert` | string | Client certificate for mutual TLS to the resolution service. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--mtls-key` | string | Private key for mtls_cert. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--acs-url` | string | Expected Destination / Recipient of the resolved Response. |
| `--in-response-to` | string | ID of the AuthnRequest the resolved Response must answer. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
